hero.title: Practical technology that stays understandable—and stays yours.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is an owner-operated technology partner for websites, automation, and business systems. I start with what you already have, add only what earns its place, and keep ownership, access, and handoff clear.

trustPoints: Configure and integrate before custom build

services.title: Start with the business problem, not a platform.
services.intro: A website project, a recurring manual task, or a messy vendor transition may need very different tools. The common thread is solving the useful problem without creating unnecessary platform sprawl.

pathways.title: Websites & Website Care
pathways.description: Build or improve a fast, accessible site with clear ownership, then keep it healthy with bounded ongoing care when that creates value.

pathways.title: Business Systems & Automation
pathways.description: Connect existing tools, remove repetitive work, and build focused internal applications only when configuration and integration leave a real gap.

pathways.title: Digital Ownership & Platform Administration
pathways.description: Untangle domains, hosting, repositories, business profiles, administrator access, vendor transitions, and ongoing platform responsibility.

pathways.title: Technology Consulting
pathways.description: Get a practical architecture, troubleshooting, or platform decision without starting from a product sale.

ownership.title: Your business should own its digital assets.
ownership.lede: Domains, hosting, repositories, cloud services, business profiles, and other critical systems should live in business-controlled accounts where practical. LDW uses named, scoped access and leaves a documented path for handoff and recovery.
items: Named or delegated access instead of shared admin credentials
MFA, recovery, rollback, and offboarding treated as normal delivery quality

process.title: Assess → Improve or Build → Handoff or Care

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: Understand the outcome, current systems, constraints, ownership, privacy, and cost before choosing technology.

steps.title: Improve or Build
steps.description: Reuse, configure, integrate, and modernize first. Add custom code only where it solves a real remaining gap.

steps.title: Handoff or Care
steps.description: Leave clear ownership and documentation, then continue with bounded care or administration only when it has a purpose.

founder.title: Work directly with the person accountable for the technical work.
founder.body: I'm Eddie Gugino, founder of Lowcountry Digital Works. I bring an IT, cybersecurity, and technical-delivery background to practical website and business-system work, with a bias toward clear ownership, scoped access, documentation, and maintainable choices.
founder.note: Founder photo and final biography wording require owner approval before production.

contact.title: You do not need a technical specification to begin.
contact.lede: Tell me what is happening today, what needs to work better, and any deadline or constraint that already matters.
